name: Oil (Brent)
summary: Brent near $92, down 13% on the month as the US pauses strikes on Iran; Hormuz still largely shut
state: Brent was near $92 early on 11 Nov, 13% lower on the month and 6% lower on the week, inside the $85–110 Watch band (Yahoo Finance). Prices eased after President Trump said on 9 Nov he would hold off new strikes on Iran, and Secretary of State Rubio said on 10 Nov there was no need for major combat operations while the naval blockade continues (CBS News). No new outage above 2 mb/d was confirmed this run.
for_you: Fuel prices remain higher than before the Gulf war. Recent falls in crude usually reach pump prices with a lag of a few weeks.

sources.title: CBS News — Live updates: Rubio says US has no need to restart combat operations in Iran

why: Oil feeds inflation, transport and household budgets; price spikes have preceded most post-war recessions.
drivers: OPEC+ output, Middle East supply risk, sanctions, demand, inventories, shipping disruption.

rubric.alert: Brent > $110, or 1-month change > +30%, or a major physical supply outage (> 2 mb/d).
